content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在集镇厂中按设计规模降序取第一条，即规模最大的集镇厂。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, code AS 厂站编码, kind AS 类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站，列出名称、编码、类型和设计规模。"}
{"sql":"SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'","explanation":"统计设备台账中所有鼓风机数量及状态为备用的数量。"}
{"sql": "SELECT d.kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(d.rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device d GROUP BY d.kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量和额定功率合计。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%' LIMIT 5", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配查询 plant 表中的设计处理规模字段。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出编码、类型等明细。"}
{"sql": "SELECT sum(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_m3_d, count(*) AS 厂站数量 FROM plant", "explanation": "汇总全区所有厂站的设计处理规模并统计厂站数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_m3h
FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取中心厂（P01）最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的进水瞬时流量，作为当前进水流量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.rated_kw = (SELECT max(rated_kw) FROM device) ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 50", "explanation": "先取设备台账中最大额定功率，再筛出与该最大值相等的全部设备并关联厂站名称"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按设备编码 P01-BL-1 取设备监测数据最新一条，返回当前运行电流。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "对昨天自然日内全部厂站的小时进水流量求和，得到全区总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取最近30分钟内各厂站最新一条实时数据，按出水总氮降序返回最高的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "从最近30分钟实时数据中按厂站取最新一条，展示各厂好氧区1、2号溶解氧。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "按厂站汇总本周（从本周一至今）plant_reading_1h 的小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "按小时表汇总中心厂昨天各小时鼓风机功率（数值等于该小时耗电量）得到总耗电量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从实时表中取协税镇污水站最近30分钟内最新一条有效MLSS读数。"}

{"sql": "WITH d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS vol FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '6 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS 天数, round(avg(vol)::numeric, 0) AS 平均每天处理水量_m3, round(sum(vol)::numeric, 0) AS 合计处理水量_m3 FROM d", "explanation": "按天汇总梁山镇污水站 10月30日至11月4日 的处理水量，再对每日水量取平均得到日均处理量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD, round(avg(h.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整点小时数据，对出水 COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷的小时均值取平均得到日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站分组统计最近24小时小时均值表中进水氨氮的平均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD平均值_mgL, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '8 hours' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "按今天上午（08:00–12:00）筛出中心厂的小时均值数据，对进水COD取平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())", "explanation": "汇总本周（周一至今）所有厂站小时表中药剂投加量，分别累加碳源和 PAC 得到全区总量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "对昨天 0 时至今日 0 时的全区小时数据汇总鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温_摄氏度, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温_摄氏度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天自然日内区域气象数据的最高和最低气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "取昨天整天的中心厂小时均值数据，对曝气风量求平均。"}

{"sql":"SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY h.hour
ORDER BY h.hour","explanation":"按小时分组汇总今天全区各厂站的小时处理水量，得到全区每小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(x.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM (SELECT plant_id, time_bucket('1 hour', ts) AS h, avg(mlss) AS mlss FROM plant_reading WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2) x JOIN plant p ON p.id = x.plant_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "plant_reading_1h 无 MLSS 字段，故用原始表按小时求均值后再取近 7 天各厂平均污泥浓度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "查协税镇 11 月 3 日（Asia/Shanghai 自然日）plant_reading_1h 中每小时出水总磷均值，按整点排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 平均出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站统计近7天小时表出水COD均值并降序取第一名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 0) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天汇总中心厂小时表的鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，两者相除得到每天的吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "统计昨天各厂站小时表处理水量合计，按水量降序取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_℃ FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '4 days' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天汇总气象表气温，取最近4个完整自然日（11月1日至4日）的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg每m3, round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "统计近7天各厂碳源投加总量与处理水量，二者相除得吨水碳源投加量（kg/m³），并按该值从高到低排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取第一条，得到COD最高的小时、所属厂站与数值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按天汇总最近7个完整自然日全区各厂站小时处理水量，倒序取水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "按本周小时数据汇总各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，计算吨水曝气电耗并升序取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计最近7天内出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站及超标小时数和最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 总磷超标小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND hour < now() AND tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（周一至今）所有厂站小时均值数据中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时记录数。"}

{"sql": "WITH h AS (
  SELECT h.plant_id,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15
                            OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS bad_hours
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
    AND h.hour <  date_trunc('day', now())
  GROUP BY h.plant_id
)
SELECT p.name AS 厂站, COALESCE(h.bad_hours, 0) AS 出水不达标小时数
FROM plant p LEFT JOIN h ON h.plant_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计昨日（前一自然日）各厂小时均值中出现 COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷或 SS 任一超一级A标准的小时数，并用 LEFT JOIN 让无超标厂站显示为 0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高出水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站 11 月 4 日全天的小时数据，按一级 A 标准（氨氮>5 mg/L）统计超标小时数并取出水氨氮小时最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮平均_毫克每升, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮最大小时均值_毫克每升, count(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂（P01）最近7天的小时均值数据，对出水总氮 tn_out 求平均并取小时均值的最大值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最大值_mg_L
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
  AND h.hour < now()
  AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5
ORDER BY h.hour ASC
LIMIT 1","explanation":"筛选协税镇本周的小时数据，按出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的条件取最早出现的小时。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表显示所属厂站。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, round(r.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s, r.ts AS 时间 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.vibration_mms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.vibration_mms DESC LIMIT 1","explanation":"筛选过去7天所有鼓风机的振动监测记录，按振动值降序取最大值及对应设备和时间。"}

{"sql":"SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_C
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.kind = '中心厂'
  AND d.kind = '鼓风机'
  AND d.status = '运行'
  AND r.running
  AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY d.code
ORDER BY d.code","explanation":"筛选中心厂运行中的鼓风机，统计过去24小时运行监测数据的平均轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 1) AS 平均电流_A, count(*) AS 运行采样点数 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵昨天处于运行状态的监测记录，按设备编码分组求平均电流。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.running = false) AS 停机分钟数 FROM plant p JOIN device d ON d.plant_id = p.id AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' LEFT JOIN device_reading r ON r.device_id = d.id AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' GROUP BY p.name, d.code", "explanation": "统计黄官镇污水站 P06-BL-1 号鼓风机在 11 月 4 日全天 running=false 的分钟记录数，即停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT r.ts AS 时间, round(r.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY r.ts LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查询黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机在11月4日当天振动首次超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h FROM weather WHERE ts >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "统计2026年10月31日全天降雨数据中的最大小时降雨强度。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS vol
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%'
    AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'
    AND h.hour <  timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 日期::text AS 日期, round(vol::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM t
UNION ALL
SELECT '10月31日较前一天增加', round((max(CASE WHEN 日期 = '2026-10-31' THEN vol END)
       - max(CASE WHEN 日期 = '2026-10-30' THEN vol END))::numeric)
FROM t", "explanation": "按日汇总梁山镇污水站 10 月 30 日与 31 日的处理水量（1h 表 inflow 求和），并给出两日差值。"}

{"sql": "WITH rain AS (
  SELECT ts, rain_mm_h,
         ts - (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts)) * interval '1 hour' AS grp
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08'
    AND ts < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
    AND rain_mm_h > 0
)
SELECT min(ts) AS 开始时间,
       max(ts) + interval '1 hour' AS 结束时间,
       round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 降雨量_mm
FROM rain
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY 开始时间;", "explanation": "筛选10月31日降雨强度大于0的时段，按连续小时分组，得到每段降雨的开始时间、结束时间和累计降雨量。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (
  SELECT r.ts, r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2
  FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%'
    AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' + interval '15 hours'
    AND r.ts <  date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' + interval '18 hours'
)
SELECT round(min(do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号溶解氧最低值,
       round(min(do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号溶解氧最低值,
       (SELECT to_char(ts, 'HH24:MI:SS') FROM t WHERE do_aerobic_1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY do_aerobic_1 ASC LIMIT 1) AS 最低值出现时间
FROM t", "explanation": "从原始表 plant_reading 取昨天15-18点黄官镇好氧区DO的最小值及出现时刻，用 date_trunc 相对 now() 定位昨天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最高值, count(*) AS 统计小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= timestamp '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamp '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name, date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date", "explanation": "筛选协税镇污水站 2026-11-03 全天的小时数据，取 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当日出水总磷峰值。"}

{"sql":"WITH max_rain_day AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
  ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.day::date AS 日期,
       round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM max_rain_day m
JOIN plant_reading_1h h
  ON h.hour >= m.day AND h.hour < m.day + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY m.day","explanation":"先找出过去7天降雨强度最大的自然日，再汇总该日全区所有厂站的处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS 水量
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days'
    AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  round(sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day')::date THEN 水量 END)::numeric) AS 昨日处理水量_m3,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days')::date THEN 水量 END)::numeric) AS 前日处理水量_m3,
  round((sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day')::date THEN 水量 END)
       - sum(CASE WHEN 日期 = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days')::date THEN 水量 END))::numeric) AS 增加量_m3
FROM t", "explanation": "按自然日汇总最近两天的全区小时处理水量，再相减得到昨日比前日多出的水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (
  SELECT p.kind, p.name, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS vol
  FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY p.id, p.kind, p.name
)
SELECT (SELECT round(vol::numeric, 0) FROM t WHERE name LIKE '%中心%') AS 中心厂处理水量_m3,
       (SELECT round(sum(vol)::numeric, 0) FROM t) AS 全区处理水量_m3,
       (SELECT round((vol / (SELECT sum(vol) FROM t) * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM t WHERE name LIKE '%中心%') AS 占比_百分比", "explanation": "按厂站汇总过去7天处理水量，再用中心厂水量除以全区总水量得到占比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - avg(h.tn_out) / avg(h.tn_in))::numeric * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "查过去7天各厂小时均值表，用 1 减去出水总氮均值与进水总氮均值的比值，得到总氮去除率。"}

{"sql": "WITH s AS ( SELECT p.id, p.name, avg(h.cod_in) AS plant_avg FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ), region AS ( SELECT avg(h.cod_in) AS region_avg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' ) SELECT s.name AS 厂站, round(s.plant_avg::numeric, 1) AS 平均进水COD, round(r.region_avg::numeric, 1) AS 全区平均COD, round((s.plant_avg - r.region_avg)::numeric, 1) AS 高出值 FROM s CROSS JOIN region r WHERE s.plant_avg > r.region_avg ORDER BY s.plant_avg DESC", "explanation": "分别计算过去7天各厂站平均进水COD与全区总体平均进水COD，筛选高于全区平均的厂站并按均值降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计昨天各厂小时处理水量之和，除以设计日规模得到负荷率百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS 工艺, count(DISTINCT p.id) AS 厂站数, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.process IN ('A2O','氧化沟') AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.process ORDER BY p.process", "explanation": "按工艺分组汇总昨天各厂站小时处理水量（inflow_m3h 求和），限定 A2O 与氧化沟两种工艺。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 运行分钟数
FROM device_reading dr
JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵'
  AND dr.running = true
  AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id","explanation":"按昨天自然日筛选污泥泵设备读数，统计 running=true 的分钟记录数（每分钟一条）得到各厂污泥泵运行分钟数。"}
